title: Synchronize Library designation browser smoke
summary: Synchronize the settings browser smoke with the completed Library designation rerender before asserting designation-specific override rows.
reason: Hosted Phase 1 reproduced the same missing Auto-designation override row on two independent runs, showing that card replacement alone was an insufficient readiness signal.
behavior_before: The helper returned on any Library card replacement and repeatedly dispatched change events while waiting, allowing assertions to observe an intermediate card with the previous designation.
behavior_after: The helper reacquires the current connected Library card, dispatches only when its rendered designation differs from the target, and returns only after a replacement card reports the requested designation; all designation-specific row assertions remain unchanged.
manual_validation: PASS: exact browser-backed settings/launch smoke completed ten consecutive local runs after connected-card reacquisition.
PASS: Ruff on the changed browser smoke.
PASS: hosted Phase 1 run 29211911806 completed the settings-launch shard, all 29 browser shards, package, release, Tauri, generated context, CodeQL, and the protected aggregate on 83f93005.
rollback_plan: Restore card-replacement-only readiness and repeated change dispatches; this also restores the observed race.
notes:
This changes test synchronization only. It does not remove, retry, or weaken any settings, designation, override-row, or launch assertion.
Wait for the requested designation on the replacement Library card before row assertions.
Refresh the settings browser smoke summary.
Hosted run 29211217268 showed the automatic-refresh guard could replace the test-held card before its change event reached the delegated handler; reacquire a connected card inside the bounded readiness loop.
